appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: Your company's brand: title, colors, logo and favicon. There is one for the whole wiki; every area looks the same.
appearance.site_title_hint: Shown in the browser tab, the top bar and the sign-in page. Up to 40 characters; empty means “Kudawiki”.
appearance.company_hint: Shown in the footer and when printing.
appearance.login_message_hint: Plain text below the form. E.g.: “For authorized staff only. Activity is logged.”
appearance.powered_by: Show “Powered by Kudawiki” in the footer
appearance.locked: Set in the configuration file: it can't be changed here.
appearance.primary_hint: Side menu, buttons, links and focus.
appearance.header_hint: The bar's text turns white or near-black on its own, by contrast.
appearance.own_sidebar: Use a different color for the side menu
appearance.sidebar_hint: Useful when the primary color is too light for a large background.
appearance.fixed_colors: The 🔒 N2/N3 levels, callouts, history changes and error or success states don't take the brand color: they mean the same in every wiki.
appearance.preview_text: This is how text looks, with a
appearance.reset_hint: Reset puts the texts and colors back to Kudawiki's; it applies when you save. Logos are removed one by one, below.
appearance.kind_hint.logo: SVG, PNG or WebP, up to 1 MB. It shows 32 px tall in the bar: horizontal works best.
appearance.kind_hint.logo_dark: Optional. For a dark top bar and dark mode; without it, the logo is used.
appearance.kind_hint.favicon: Square. If you don't upload one, it's made from the logo.
appearance.unsupported: That file isn't a usable image. SVG, PNG or WebP are accepted.
appearance.warning.link_darkened: Your color is too light for text; links will use {color}.
appearance.warning.favicon_not_square: The favicon isn't square: it will look shrunk or padded in the tab.
appearance.warning.logo_too_small: The logo is under 64 px tall: it will look blurry on high-density screens. An SVG or a larger PNG works better.
appearance.warning.logo_low_contrast: The logo barely stands out from the top bar color. Try another bar color or upload a logo for dark backgrounds.
appearance.warning.svg_not_rasterized: This SVG couldn't be turned into an image (it uses unsupported filters or fonts), so there are no tab icons. Upload a PNG favicon too.
profile.title: My profile

profile.photo_unsupported: That file can't be used as a photo. Upload a PNG, JPG or WebP.
profile.email_hint: Your email is changed by the wiki administrator.
profile.invalid_name: Enter your name: up to 120 characters, on a single line.
profile.areas_hint: Your role in each area is assigned by its administrator.
profile.password_hint: At least 10 characters. A long phrase is easier to remember and harder to guess.
profile.revoke_others: Sign me out on other devices and browsers

email.link_hint: If the button doesn't work, paste this link into your browser:
email.sent_by: This email was sent by {site}, the wiki at {url}.
email.test.subject: Test email from {site}
email.test.title: Email works
email.test.p1: This is a test email from {site}, sent from Administration → Email.
email.test.p2: If you see it with the company's logo and colors, the wiki's emails will look like this.
smtp.title: Email
smtp.intro: The server the wiki sends its emails with: invitations, password recovery and notices. Without a server, notices stay inside the wiki. Emails go out with the logo and colors from Appearance.
smtp.disabled: Email is off: the server or the sender is missing.
smtp.host_hint: The name or IP, without smtp://. Empty turns email off.
smtp.security_hint.starttls: The connection starts in plain text and is encrypted before anything is sent; if the server doesn't offer it, nothing is sent. Usual port: 587.
smtp.security_hint.tls: The connection is encrypted from the first byte. Usual port: 465.
smtp.security_hint.none: Only for a relay on the same network. Without encryption the password is never sent: with a username, it only works with a server on this same machine.
smtp.port_hint: Changes on its own when you pick the encryption, if it was still the usual one.
smtp.username_hint: Empty if the server doesn't ask to authenticate.
smtp.password_hint: Stored encrypted and never shown. Leave it as is to keep it; clear it and save to remove it.
smtp.from_hint: The address emails are sent from. The name recipients see is the site title.
smtp.test_hint: Sent right away to your email, {email}, with the company branding. If the server rejects it, you'll see its answer here.
smtp.test_sent: Done: the server accepted the email. Check the inbox of {email} (and the spam folder).
error.invalid_smtp: Check the settings: the server without spaces or smtp://, the port between 1 and 65535 and the sender as a single address (wiki@company.com).
error.smtp_locked: That setting is fixed in the configuration file: change it there.
error.smtp_not_configured: The server and the sender are not configured yet.
error.smtp_failed: The email could not be sent. This is what the server or the network said:
email.invite.subject: You're invited to {site}
email.invite.title: You're invited to {site}
email.invite.p1: Hi, {name}. {inviter} gave you an account on {site}.
email.invite.p2: Choose your password with the button. The link is valid for {days} days and works only once; afterwards you sign in with your email, {email}.
email.password_reset.subject: Choose a new password for {site}
email.password_reset.title: Choose a new password
email.password_reset.p1: Hi, {name}. A new password was requested for your {site} account on {when}, from IP address {ip}.
email.password_reset.p2: The link is valid for {minutes} minutes and works only once.
email.password_reset.p3: If you didn't ask for it, ignore this email: your password hasn't changed.
email.password_changed.subject: Your {site} password changed
email.password_changed.title: Your password changed
email.password_changed.p1: Hi, {name}. The password of your {site} account changed on {when}.
email.password_changed.p2: If it was you, there's nothing to do.
email.password_changed.p3: If it wasn't you, tell whoever runs the wiki right away: someone else may be using your account.
email.superadmin_password_reset.subject: A superadmin reset their password on {site}
email.superadmin_password_reset.title: A superadmin reset their password
email.superadmin_password_reset.p1: {name} ({email}) reset their superadmin password with an email link on {when}.
email.superadmin_password_reset.p2: If you didn't expect it, check with that person and review the audit log: whoever controls their email controls their account.
reset.forgot_intro: Type your account's email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
reset.sent: If the email belongs to an account, a link will arrive in a few minutes. Check your spam folder too.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.sessions_note: Saving it signs you out on every device.
reset.done: Done. Your password changed and your sessions were closed; sign in with the new one.
reset.expired: This link has expired or was already used.
admin.reset_label: Send {name} a link to reset their password
admin.reset_link: Link for {email} to choose a new password. It's shown only once and expires in minutes: hand it over now, through a secure channel.
admin.reset_emailed: We emailed {email} a link to choose a new password.
admin.invite_emailed: We emailed the invitation to {email}. The link is valid for 7 days.
error.invalid_reset: This link has expired or was already used.
error.same_password: The new password has to be different from the current one.
error.no_local_password: That person hasn't accepted their invitation yet: resend the invitation.
error.reset_unavailable: Email recovery isn't available: ask whoever runs the wiki for help.
audit.auth.password_reset_request: Asked for a password reset link
audit.auth.password_reset_complete: Reset their password with a link
error.approval_required: Changes on this path go through review: send them as a proposal.
error.needs_rebase: The page changed and the proposal clashes with those changes: it has to be redone on the current version.
error.no_changes: The proposal doesn't change anything on the page.
error.comment_required: To reject, write a comment: the author needs to know what to fix.
error.proposal_closed: This proposal has already been resolved.
error.self_approval: You can't approve your own proposal: another admin in this area can do it.
error.invalid_override: Check the path and the mode of the exception.
proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.pick: Pick a proposal from the list to review it.
proposals.changed_clean: The page changed since the proposal was made (it's now at revision {n}). It merged without conflicts.
proposals.changed_conflict: The page changed since the proposal was made (it's now at revision {n}) and the changes clash. It has to be redone on the current version before it can be approved.
proposals.comment_hint: Optional when approving, required when rejecting
proposals.merged_same: Approved by {name}; the page already said that, so there was no new revision.
proposals.rejected_line: Rejected by {name}. You can fix it and resubmit it, or withdraw it.
editor.propose_note: Your changes reach the area admins as a proposal and are published when one of them approves. The path, level and metadata can't be changed through a proposal.
editor.rebase_title: The page changed since the proposal (it's now at revision {n})
editor.rebase_body: These are the changes the page had. Redo the proposal on top of them: when you save, it moves to revision {n}.
editor.comment_placeholder: Optional: the author will see it
settings.approval_direct: Direct: editors and admins publish when they save.
settings.approval_required: With review: what editors change waits for an area admin's approval.
settings.viewers_hint: A viewer proposes changes to the pages they already read; they always go through review.
settings.overrides_hint: A folder can use a different mode than the area; if there are several, the longest path wins. Each page's level still decides who can edit it.
settings.override_none: No exceptions: the whole area uses the same mode.
toolbar.label: Formatting
toolbar.heading: Heading: section, subsection or text
image.menu_none: Put the cursor on an image (or upload one) to change its size and position.
image.beside: Side by side with the image below
image.hint: Saved as in Wiki.js: =50% or =480x for the size, and {.align-center}, {.align-left} or {.align-right} for the position.
mdguide.image_center.desc: Centered image, a quarter of the page width
mdguide.image_left.desc: Image on the left with the text beside it; {.align-right}, on the right
mdguide.image_size.desc: Image 480 px wide, as in Wiki.js; =50% makes it half the page width, =480x270 sets width and height. The Image: size and position button writes it for you
mdguide.image_row.desc: Two images side by side: with a size and on the same line. If they don't fit, the second moves down
secret.show: Hidden text: click to show it
error.secret_in_heading: Hidden text can't go in a section heading: the heading shows in the table of contents and in the page address.
error.secret_unclosed: A [[secret:…]] must close with ]] on the same line; otherwise it would show as is. To hide several lines or paragraphs, select them and press the lock (it writes :::secret … :::).
mdguide.secret_block.desc: Several hidden lines or paragraphs, with lists or bold inside. The lock writes it for you when more than one line is selected.
mdguide.secret.desc: Hidden text, like a password: shown with a click, and copying gives [redacted]. Anyone who reads the page can see it; for real secrets, use sealed documents.
secret.warn_title: Keeping passwords in documentation isn't recommended
secret.warn_body: (ISO/IEC 27002, control 5.17). Hidden text only covers it on screen: anyone who can read this page can see it, and it stays in the history. If you can, keep it in a password manager and say here where to find it.
email.unsubscribe: I don't want these notifications by email
email.proposal_pending.subject: Proposal to review in {area}: {title}
email.proposal_pending.title: There's a proposal to review
email.proposal_pending.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} proposed a change to “{title}” in the {area} area.
email.proposal_pending.p2: As an admin of the area, you can approve it, edit it before approving, or send it back with a comment.
email.proposal_reminder.subject: A proposal has been waiting {days} days: {title}
email.proposal_reminder.title: A proposal is still waiting
email.proposal_reminder.p1: Hi, {name}. The proposal “{title}” in the {area} area has gone {days} days without review.
email.proposal_reminder.p2: Its author can't publish the change until someone approves it.
email.proposal_approved.subject: Your proposal was approved: {title}
email.proposal_approved.title: Your proposal was published
email.proposal_approved.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} approved your proposal “{title}” in the {area} area.
email.proposal_approved.p2: The change is live and shows under your name in the history.
email.proposal_rejected.subject: Your proposal came back with a comment: {title}
email.proposal_rejected.title: Your proposal came back with a comment
email.proposal_rejected.p1: Hi, {name}. {actor} sent back your proposal “{title}” in the {area} area.
email.proposal_rejected.p2: Read the comment: you can fix it and send it again, or withdraw it.
email.proposal_rebase.subject: Your proposal needs to be redone: {title}
email.proposal_rebase.title: The page changed and your proposal clashes
email.proposal_rebase.p1: Hi, {name}. A change was published to “{title}” in the {area} area that touches the same lines as your proposal.
email.proposal_rebase.p2: Open it to see what changed and redo it on top of the current version.
email.page_changed.subject: “{title}” changed
email.page_changed.title: A page you follow changed
email.page_changed.p2: If it keeps changing before you open it, you won't get another email.
email.page_deleted.subject: “{title}” was deleted
email.page_deleted.title: A page you follow was deleted
email.page_deleted.p2: It stays in the area's trash for a while: if it was a mistake, an admin or whoever deleted it can restore it.
email.digest.subject: Your {site} notifications ({count})
email.digest.title: Your unread notifications
email.digest.p1: Hi, {name}. This happened in the wiki since your last summary:
email.line.proposal_reminder: The proposal “{title}” has been waiting {days} days ({area})
email.line.proposal_rebase: Your proposal “{title}” needs to be redone ({area})
notif.title: Notifications
notif.kind.proposal_pending_many: {count} new proposals to review; the latest, “{title}”
notif.kind.proposal_reminder: “{title}” has been waiting for review {days} days
notif.kind.proposal_rebase: The page changed: your proposal “{title}” needs to be redone
notif.auto_watch: Follow the pages I create or edit
notif.inbox_note: Notifications always reach the bell. To stop getting them for a page, unfollow it.
notif.email_note: A notification is emailed only if it's still unread a while later; if you open the page first, it isn't sent. Until you read it, you won't get another one on the same topic.
notif.email_off: The wiki's email isn't set up: for now notifications only reach the bell.
notif.cat.proposals: Proposals to review (if you manage an area)
watch.label: Watch page
watch.via: You already follow it because you follow “{page}” and its subpages.
watch.note: We'll let you know in the bell when someone changes or deletes it.
unsub.title: Stop notification emails
unsub.body: You'll stop getting notification emails for: {what}. In the wiki, the bell still shows them.
unsub.done: Done: you won't get those emails anymore. You can turn them back on in your profile.
unsub.invalid: This link isn't valid or is incomplete.
audit.revision.purge: Deleted old revisions under the history retention
error.summary_required: This area asks for a change summary: write in one line what you changed.
error.media_in_use: A page still uses this file.
history.trimmed: Revisions before {n} were deleted under the area's history retention.
settings.require_summary: Ask for a change summary when editing a page
settings.require_summary_hint: The editor won't save or propose a change without a summary. Creating a page doesn't ask for one.
settings.keep_days_before: Keep the revisions of the last
settings.keep_hint: The rest are deleted every night. A page's current version and the version an open proposal was written on are never deleted.
files.title: Files
files.intro: What was uploaded to the area and you can see. A file no page uses is deleted after 7 days.
files.none: There are no files in this area yet.
files.copy_failed: The link could not be copied.
files.in_use: Not deleted: first remove it from
